name: memory-learned-save
description: The user states a lasting fact about a partner with none of the fixed phrases that make a memory told (Story 41.8). OcuTalon may save it unasked, and when it does it says so in one short sentence. It is scored in its own report-only line, not in the commands score or in SM-1, until a release-candidate run on Claude Haiku 5.5 has measured it: it is right when the reply says that OcuTalon will remember the fact.

turn.text: The Results partner's contact is Lee, and their test desk answers on weekdays.
